title: Instant-Fold: In-Context Imitation Learning for Deformable Object Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.04269v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deformable object manipulation (DOM) is challenging due to high-dimensional, partially observable states that evolve through long-horizon, topology-changing interactions with multiple valid manipulation modes. We introduce Instant-Fold, an in-context imitation learning framework for DOM. Given a single human demonstration, our policy infers and executes diverse manipulation modes directly from the demonstration, including variations in spatial execution and ordering, without requiring gradient updates. Our approach first learns deformation-aware visual representations via temporal contrastive pretraining, after which a flow-matching transformer policy conditioned on the demonstration predicts actions to execute the intended manipulation mode. Trained entirely in simulation, Instant-Fold generalizes across diverse folding modes and transfers zero-shot to real-world settings without additional data collection or finetuning. Video

translated_title: Instant-Fold：面向可变形物体操作的上下文内模仿学习
translated_abstract: 可变形物体操作（DOM）具有挑战性，因为其状态高维且部分可观测，并会在长时程、拓扑结构变化的交互中演化，同时存在多种有效的操作模式。我们提出了 Instant-Fold，一个面向可变形物体操作的上下文内模仿学习框架。仅需单个人类示范，我们的策略即可直接从示范中推断并执行多样化的操作模式，包括空间执行方式和先后顺序的变化，而无需梯度更新。我们的方法首先通过时序对比预训练学习形变感知的视觉表示，随后以示范为条件的流匹配 Transformer 策略预测动作，以执行预期的操作模式。Instant-Fold 完全在仿真中训练，能够泛化到多种折叠模式，并以零样本方式迁移到真实世界环境，无需额外的数据采集或微调。
tldr: Instant-Fold 提出了一种上下文内模仿学习框架，仅需单个人类示范即可在无需梯度更新的情况下推断并执行多样化的可变形物体操作模式，并实现从仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移。
